verdict.rationale: The Search API documents "multi-query search" (docs-17), which is a first-party way to submit several queries in one request. That is a narrow form of bulk operation, with no further detail on limits or behavior. Async clients, rate-limit tiers and CLI shell pipelines are developer building blocks or workarounds and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk endpoint for Agent/Sonar requests, multi-query limits and semantics, bulk job status/results handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
